audit.why: Riot's text: Granite Shield absorbs damage up to 10% of his max Health and recharges if he has not been hit for a few seconds — it is a DAMAGE SHIELD, and above 50 Fury Ruthless Predator destroys damage shields on the target, so the empowered opener deletes it and the trade is paid at full price. notes:
The decisive fact was missing everywhere: Granite Shield is a damage shield, and a 50-Fury Ruthless Predator destroys damage shields on the target. The page treated the shield as an unavoidable tax that made every trade inefficient, when opening empowered simply deletes it. Second, Ground Slam's damage is armour-scaling, which makes empowered Slice and Dice's armour reduction a two-way effect — it was framed only as your own damage buff.

Not asserted, matching the mirror: the kit file tags Seismic Shard (Q) and Ground Slam (E) with a 'grounding' flag, but Riot's descriptions give only a move-speed steal and an attack-speed slow. Malphite grounds nothing, so I wrote no dash-denial claim. Unstoppable Force also carries a spurious 'projectile' flag; it is a self-dash, so no Wind Wall-class claim was made either.
